data.title: Check a product enclosure around a component
data.summary: A 60 by 40 by 15 mm component proxy, 2 mm wall and 1 mm clearance. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Modifiers change evaluated geometry through an editable operation stack.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender / COLMAP / Nerfstudio environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: A 60 by 40 by 15 mm component proxy, 2 mm wall and 1 mm clearance.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent enclosure fit workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: A 60 by 40 by 15 mm component proxy, 2 mm wall and 1 mm clearance. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Set metric units and use a measured component bounding box
Construct the outer shell and subtract the clearance envelope on a derived copy
Inspect sections at connectors and mounting points; export a dimension receipt

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned check a product enclosure around a component candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: The component does not intersect the intended internal clearance volume
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: Mesh Boolean output is not a replacement for manufacturing CAD tolerance analysis.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Separate clearance dimensions from wall dimensions in the parameter table.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me check a product enclosure around a component in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: A 60 by 40 by 15 mm component proxy, 2 mm wall and 1 mm clearance. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: The component does not intersect the intended internal clearance volume; All connector openings remain accessible. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.

troubleshooting.symptom: An operator, node socket or exporter option is unavailable
troubleshooting.action: Stop and inspect the installed tool/version documentation; adapt the smallest affected step rather than guessing an API name.

troubleshooting.symptom: The candidate fails its stated review condition
troubleshooting.action: Return to the last accepted source/parameter set, reduce to one representative case and record the failed observation. Separate clearance dimensions from wall dimensions in the parameter table.
